verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is Trello's REST API reference listing a 'Search' section. That shows a first-party search capability exists, but the pack says nothing about what it covers or how well it performs. Missing for 10: evidence that search spans cards/tasks, attached docs, and comments; any end-user search UI documentation; evidence of speed or result accuracy; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can search across all tasks, docs, and comments and get fast, accurate results
